request: 사용자 명시 지시: 왼쪽 신규 공고 수정. 전체 코드 잠금을 지시한 파일·영역 변경 검사로 교체. 바로 진행해.

patches.before:
- name: 승인된 공고 틀 변경 차단
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -n "$BASE_SHA" ]; then
            git fetch --no-tags origin "$BASE_SHA"
          else
            BASE_SHA=HEAD
          fi
          trusted=$(mktemp -d)
          if git cat-file -e "$BASE_SHA:scripts/check-approved-layout.mjs" 2>/dev/null; then
            git show "$BASE_SHA:scripts/check-approved-layout.mjs" > "$trusted/check-approved-layout.mjs"
            git show "$BASE_SHA:scripts/approved-layout-lock.json" > "$trusted/approved-layout-lock.json"
            node "$trusted/check-approved-layout.mjs" "$PWD" "$trusted/approved-layout-lock.json" --trusted
          else
            node scripts/check-approved-layout.mjs
          fi
          node scripts/test-approved-layout-lock.mjs
patches.after:
- name: 작업 시작 문서·수정 범위 대조
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -n "$BASE_SHA" ]; then
            git fetch --no-tags origin "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA"
            trusted=$(mktemp -d)
            if git cat-file -e "$BASE_SHA:scripts/check-work-scope.mjs" 2>/dev/null; then
              git show "$BASE_SHA:scripts/check-work-scope.mjs" > "$trusted/check-work-scope.mjs"
              node "$trusted/check-work-scope.mjs" "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA"
            else
              node scripts/check-work-scope.mjs "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA"
            fi
          fi
          node scripts/test-work-scope.mjs

patches.before:
name: 승인된 공고 틀 보호 (기준 브랜치에서 실행)

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]

# No secrets, no candidate code execution, no persisted checkout credentials.
permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  # Existing protected-branch context: checks. Both this trusted guard and PR checks must pass.
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: 기준 브랜치 검사기로 변경 코드·기준표·검사 우회 차단
        env:
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$HEAD_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          git fetch --no-tags origin "$HEAD_SHA"
          candidate=$(mktemp -d)
          git archive "$HEAD_SHA" | tar -x -C "$candidate"
          node scripts/check-approved-layout.mjs "$candidate" "$PWD/scripts/approved-layout-lock.json" --trusted
patches.after:
name: 작업 범위 보호 (기준 브랜치에서 실행)

on:
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]

# Only trusted-base code executes. No candidate code, secrets or saved credentials.
permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: 사전 작업 범위 밖의 파일·영역 변경 차단
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$BASE_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          [[ "$HEAD_SHA" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          git fetch --no-tags origin "$HEAD_SHA"
          node scripts/check-work-scope.mjs "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA"

- name: 공고 이미지 유무별 틀 동일성 검사
